mean_cn: n.【财】读者人数；(某一报刊杂志等的)读者群
mean_en: the audience reached by written communications (books or magazines or newspapers etc.)
sentence: The placing of advertisements only where the readership is predominantly of one race or sex is construed as indirect discrimination.
sentence_trans: 将广告仅投放在读者主要为某一种族或性别的地方被视为间接歧视。
